standalone_control.compile_argv_not_reconstructed_from_log: Use the unchanged standalone source as the entry; bind actual original compile invocation/target/ELF if a fresh control is later selected. This preparation does not manufacture compiler or Linux-runtime evidence.

original_controller_bundle.label_scope: These are the original fixed labels checked by the unchanged controller, not a claim that diagnostic185 is acceptedE. No new three-window runtime plan is selected or executed here.

accounting.cached_step: Scope covers entire step_udp including receive, admission, process_udp, send and owned drops; classify only actual QueryResult::Cached.
accounting.denominator: Read actual meter queries[cached]. This includes true cache hits during the1000-query prewarm as well as warmup/measurement; never substitute5000.
accounting.whole_turn: Record all no-packet/cached-only/mixed-or-other owner turns separately; cached-only turns are conditional and include wait/control work. Sum all rows for whole normal-owner-loop totals, not process-lifetime startup/output/shutdown.
accounting.bytes: Requested/released allocator bytes, not RSS/USS or physical malloc footprint; successful realloc recorded separately.

output_requirements: Case/group exit0 and COMPLETE; unchanged set-e case must pass final wait for the daemon, establishing normal daemon exit0.
Original validate() plus complete1000-query prewarm, zero wrong/timeout/transport/skips; upstream hit rules unchanged.
Live and file diagnostic ELF identity; exactly one daemon thread in before/resources/after observations.
udp-alloc.json exists after owner exit; nested_steps=0 and unscoped_classifications=0.
Keep all kind/query/totals/turn matrices and histogram; reject malformed dimensions or inconsistent cached denominator/histogram sums.

unchanged_semantics: Consumed packet steps include1000prewarm plus1000warmup plus4000measurement; cached denominator is the actual cached count, never a substituted5000.
Preserve cached-step and all three whole-turn matrices; conditional cached-only turns never stand for entire process lifetime.
Require correct dimensions/nonnegative integer counts/full histogram and same cached denominator in step/turn totals.
Measured workload must have exactly one process/thread, nested_steps=0 and unscoped_classifications=0. The standalone control deliberately has unscoped=1 and is not a valid measured window.
Require complete original traffic/identity/health checks and actual final daemon exit0; report-file existence alone is insufficient.
Requested/released allocator byte traffic is not RSS/USS, live heap or copied physical bytes.
All instrumented CPU/latency/ELF-size comparisons are excluded from product performance or release claims.
runtime_decision: Root selects source and order from actual C/185 profile after its postflight/review; this entry grants no upload/build/device action.
